login.title: Kubuela mu tshisanji
login.portalName: Tshiibi tshia muena mudimu wa tshisanji
login.welcome: Tuasakidila! Buela bua kulombola bantu badi bakulombola.
login.heroTitle: Kudimuna mudimu webe wa disumba dia nzubu ne madimi ne bantu bonso baudi ulua nabu
login.heroIntro: Tshiibi tshimue tshia kufunda natshi bakiliya kudi bibaki, ikala ne lumu lua bantu badi bakulombola ne ubalonde too ne padibu bafunda.

register.title: Funda bantu mu masekonde
register.text: Tuma muena mudimu webe ne mudimu udiye musue.

protect.title: Dikuba dia misangu ibidi
protect.text: Tshintu tshieba tshidi tshishala tshiebe bua tshikondo tshia bukubi, nunku muntu mukuabu kena mua kulomba muena mudimu wa muomumue to.

track.title: Londa tshitupa tshionso
track.text: Tangila nsombelu wa muntu yonso ne malu ende onso, kubangila ku dipetangana dia kumpala too ne ku difunda.

handover.title: Makuta paudi ufunda
handover.text: Padi muena mudimu ufunda, badi bafila tshintu tshia kumpala kudi muibaki ne wewe mufunda bu muena mudimu wa kumpala.

login.secure: Dibuela mu bukubi - malu a bakiliya bebe adi ashala masokoka

signup.title: Difundisha dia muena mudimu wa tshisanji
signup.intro: Enza kazubu kebe bua kutuadija kudifundisha ne kulombola bantu baudi ukeba.
signup.partnerName: Dîna dia muena mudimu wa tshisanji *
